name: IEC 60906-1 / NBR 14136 (Type N)
description: Recessed three-round-pin household system: line and neutral pins 19 mm apart and an earth pin slightly offset between them. IEC 60906-1 defines a 16 A, 250 V version (adopted in South Africa as SANS 164-2); Brazil's NBR 14136 derives from it with 10 A (4.0 mm pins) and 20 A (4.8 mm pins) sizes that do not follow the IEC pin dimensions.

notes: The IEC 60906-1 rating comes from the IEC abstract; the pin layout, the 3 mm earth offset and the polarity come from secondary sources.
Line on the right looking into the IEC 60906-1 socket-outlet with the earth offset up relies on a single secondary source (Wikipedia); the drawing follows it.
Earth-to-line distance differs between secondary sources (a 3 mm offset gives about 10 mm; one site gives 10.2 mm); the drawing uses the 3 mm offset.

NBR 14136 pin spacing and earth offset are not stated by the cited sources; NBR 14136 does not follow the IEC 60906-1 pin dimensions, and physical mating between IEC 60906-1 and NBR 14136 parts is not recorded.
NBR 14136 polarity (which pin carries the line) is not stated by the cited sources.
Frequency is not stated by the cited sources.
Unearthed two-pin NBR plugs are not modelled; the Europlug (Type C), which fits NBR 14136 sockets, is mated from the 'europlug' family.
SANS 164-2 is treated as the IEC 60906-1 configuration; its 16 A rating was not checked against the SANS text.
